title: Google's Strongest AI Opened At $2. It Doubles Dec 1.
description:
Gemini 4 Carbon is on the API for all paying developers (Nov 10): $2 in / $10 out per 1M tokens through Nov 30, then $4 / $20 from Dec 1, 2026. No free tier. Sources: blog.google (Gemini 4 Carbon now available), aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing
